about: The catalogues of the koha.nexus local gateway (127.0.0.1:5000), one per /sru/{id}; /sru/_union searches them all. Every search answers from static.db first (records of the source whose id is the target's id, or the ids listed in "static"). kind z3950 and sru targets are also searched live (native protocol only, a 6 s budget) when static.db has nothing; zeus, pergamum and missing ones answer from static.db only, since clients never scrape. status: verified (searched live, MARC came back), untested, broken (its address does not answer; never searched live), missing (no address). local_first (1-5): the catalogues static.db holds nearly whole (UNESP, UFPR, UNIFESP, UnB, UFU); their Koha rows are ticked and ranked first, on-demand enrichment searches their static.db records before any server, and a library row whose host is one of legacy_hosts (or a subdomain) becomes their fallback.
